## If this touches Lithuanian content

- [ ] Every new word has a dictionary form, an English gloss, a respelling and a category
- [ ] Commands are imperatives, not infinitives (`Stok!`, not `Stoti!`)
- [ ] Case government is stated for any new preposition or verb that takes one
- [ ] `npm run content:validate` passes
- [ ] I have stated my source or my basis for the Lithuanian in the PR description

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behaviour I changed
- [ ] I checked the change on a phone-sized viewport
